metadata.coverage: Selected sourced reports; not an exhaustive inventory of Nairobi flood-prone roads or incidents.
metadata.geolocation: OSM place nodes or nearest OSM road vertex to an editorial reference location. Road reports rarely specify an exact surveyed point. Bellevue reference uses OSM footbridge way 584887780; T-Mall uses building way 232666539.
metadata.animation: Editorial camera tour and decorative pin rings, not flood onset, extent growth, depth or water velocity.
metadata.licence: Geometry copyright OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Original paraphrased report summaries retain links and dates. No article text or images redistributed.
